cohort: Pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) receiving either routine or standardized treatment at a hospital.
finding: Standardized treatment for GDM significantly improved maternal blood glucose control and reduced the incidence of fetal macrosomia and fetal distress, compared to routine treatment.
mod_finding: There were no statistically significant differences in the incidence of caesarean section between the standardized treatment group and the control group.
